correctness.rationale: The established vertex coordinates give Gaussian supports Z_ab/sqrt(2) for iid corner-entry normals and an exact width identity R_n/(sqrt(2)||G_n^circ||). For any epsilon the Gaussian tail sum over all a,b is finite, so Z_ab tends uniformly to 0 at large a+b a.s.; the first-row random walk oscillates in both signs, giving attained unique nonzero extrema and eventual exact stability. Projection changes support scores by a common scalar. In dimension n(n-1)/2-1, the projected chi norm divided by n tends to 1/sqrt(2) a.s.; polar independence and gamma moments give all positive-moment limits. Conditioning on xi_11 gives E[1-Phi(T)] and strict angle decrease from independent added competitors. Independently reconstructed all block vertices and support/Frobenius identities in n=3..10, 8 independent arrays per n. The random finite checks do not prove the infinite index claims.
